# GMM Estimation of Mean-Variance Frontier

These notes are about how we can use GMM and the delta method to estimate a mean-variance frontier and also calculate a confidence band for the frontier. The purpose is to provide a quick repetition of GMM and the delta method - and to teach you how to implement it in Python. The approach in these notes is threfore very practical. 

## GMM Estimation of Means and Covariance Matrices

Let $R_t$ be a vector of net returns of $N$ assets. We want to estimate the mean vector and the covariance matrix. The moment conditions for the mean vector are:

$$
\mathbb{E}[R_t] - \mu = 0_{N\times1}
$$

and the moment conditions for the second moment matrix are:

$$
\mathbb{E} R_t R'_t-\Gamma = 0_{N \times N}
$$

Example 1. With $N=2$ we have:

$$
\mathbb{E} \begin{bmatrix}
R_{1t} \\
R_{2t}
\end{bmatrix} - \begin{bmatrix}
\mu_1 \\
\mu_2
\end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix}
0 \\
0
\end{bmatrix}
$$

and 

$$
\mathbb{E}\begin{bmatrix}
R^2_{1t} & R_{1t}R_{2t} \\
R_{2t}R_{1t} & R^2_{2t}
\end{bmatrix}
-
\begin{bmatrix}
\Gamma_{11} & \Gamma_{12} \\
\Gamma_{21} & \Gamma_{22}
\end{bmatrix} = 
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & 0 \\
0 & 0
\end{bmatrix}
$$
